snippet.title: Time To Wake Up - Official Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2509870/Time_To_Wake_Up

Stuck in a dream, you hear a voice in need of your eyes. Blink and refresh your memory to escape the shadows of your past.

Keep your eyes peeled in Time To Wake Up, an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself in a dream filled with various school memories.
